elements.element: Array must maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(a) requires Array to maintain commercial general liability insurance.

elements.element: The commercial general liability insurance must have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(a) specifies not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: The commercial general liability insurance must have an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(a) specifies not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Array must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(b) expressly requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: The professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(b) specifies not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Array processes Customer Data, Array must maintain cyber/privacy insurance.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(c) is triggered only to the extent Array processes personal data or Confidential Information of Ono and requires only 'cyber liability insurance.' It does not use or establish the full Customer Data trigger or expressly require privacy coverage. The record does not demonstrate that Array does not process Customer Data.

elements.element: The cyber/privacy insurance required for processing Customer Data must have a limit of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although Section 18.15(c) states a USD 5,000,000 limit, that limit applies under the narrower personal-data-or-Confidential-Information trigger rather than whenever Array processes Customer Data, and the coverage is not expressly cyber/privacy insurance.

elements.element: Array must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(d) requires workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law.

elements.element: Array must provide Ono with certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The final sentence requires Array to provide Ono with certificates evidencing the coverage upon request.

elements.element: Array must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a limit of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 18.15(b) requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000, exceeding the fallback limit.

elements.element: If Array processes Customer Data, Array must maintain cyber/privacy insurance with a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The stated USD 5,000,000 limit exceeds the fallback amount, but Section 18.15(c) uses a narrower trigger—processing personal data or Confidential Information of Ono—and does not expressly require privacy coverage. There is no evidence that the Customer Data condition is absent.

result.reason: The clause meets the CGL, E&O, workers' compensation, and certificate requirements, including the preferred monetary limits. It does not fully meet either level because the cyber obligation is not triggered by all processing of Customer Data and does not expressly require privacy coverage. The redline is not minimal because it additionally imposes a one-year post-Term tail, products liability, clinical-trial liability, and unnecessary relocation of existing provisions. Those changes do not facially contradict or disable the existing unrelated terms.
